sources.name: Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 (Consumer Protection Law)
Federal Decree-Law No. 42 of 2022 (Civil Procedure Law)

steps.title: Filing of Consumer Complaint or Commercial Claim
steps.description: Consumer complaint is filed with the Consumer Protection Department, or a commercial claim is filed before the competent court having jurisdiction.

steps.title: Review and Mediation
steps.description: Consumer authority may review the complaint and attempt mediation or settlement between the parties, where applicable.

steps.title: Referral to Court
steps.description: If settlement is not reached or for commercial disputes, the matter proceeds before the competent civil or commercial court.

steps.title: Court Proceedings
steps.description: Court conducts hearings, reviews evidence, and considers submissions of the parties.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court issues a judgment resolving the consumer or commercial dispute.

steps.title: Execution
steps.description: Judgment may be executed through execution procedures if not complied with voluntarily.

documents_required: Consumer complaint or statement of claim

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against judgment as permitted under UAE law
Appeal on points of law as permitted under UAE law
